SELECT oPerson."XCL_0273" AS oPerson_hasPersonName,
       oListedSecurity."XCL_0226" AS oListedSecurity_hasLegalName,
       oListedSecurity."XCL_0225" AS oListedSecurity_hasTickerSymbol,
       oSecuritiesTransaction."XCL_0328" AS oSecuritiesTransaction_hasType,
       oSecuritiesTransaction."XCL_0329" AS oSecuritiesTransaction_hasSettlementDate,
       oMonetaryAmount."XCL_0243" AS oMonetaryAmount_hasAmount
FROM "XTB_058" AS FinancialServiceAccount1
INNER JOIN "XTB_130" AS oSecuritiesTransaction ON FinancialServiceAccount1."XCL_0153" = oSecuritiesTransaction."XCL_0325"
INNER JOIN "XTB_108" AS oPerson ON FinancialServiceAccount1."XCL_0154" = oPerson."XCL_0268"
INNER JOIN "XTB_087" AS oListedSecurity ON oSecuritiesTransaction."XCL_0327" = oListedSecurity."XCL_0222"
INNER JOIN "XTB_095" AS oMonetaryAmount ON oSecuritiesTransaction."XCL_0326" = oMonetaryAmount."XCL_0241"
WHERE oSecuritiesTransaction."XCL_0328" = '1'
  AND oSecuritiesTransaction."XCL_0329" >= '2015-06-15'
  AND oSecuritiesTransaction."XCL_0329" <= '2016-06-15'
  AND oMonetaryAmount."XCL_0243" < (
      SELECT oInnerMonetaryAmount."XCL_0243"
      FROM "XTB_087" AS oInnerListedSecurity
      INNER JOIN "XTB_095" AS oInnerMonetaryAmount ON oInnerListedSecurity."XCL_0223" = oInnerMonetaryAmount."XCL_0241"
      WHERE oListedSecurity."XCL_0225" = oInnerListedSecurity."XCL_0225"
      LIMIT 1
  )
